title: NEURONIX Execution Receipt Schema
description: Cryptographically verifiable receipt produced upon completion of an Operational Contract Envelope.

receipt_id.description: Unique deterministic identifier for the receipt.

envelope_hash.description: RFC 8785 SHA-256 hash of the executing OperationalContractEnvelope.

provider_id.description: Identifier of the ExecutionProvider that executed the workload.

exit_code.description: POSIX process exit code (0 for success).

state_root_after.description: Observed StateRoot hash immediately following execution.

peak_rss_bytes.description: Peak Resident Set Size in bytes.

cpu_time_ms.description: Total user and system CPU time consumed in milliseconds.

stdout_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of standard output stream.

stderr_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of standard error stream.

evidence_digest.description: Cumulative cryptographic evidence hash bound to EvidenceRoot.

invariants_verified.description: List of formal security invariants verified during and after execution.
